transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Festival Sustainability Coordinator. Before I can approve the operating package for the Saturday evening closing concert at Riverside Park, we need to go through our standard joint operations review. I'd like to hear from each of you — electrical, permitting, transport, and accessibility leads — on whether you have any required changes to the current draft. The draft currently includes a diesel generator, mixed-waste bins, shuttle pickup at the West Gate every 30 minutes, and an accessible audience route from the main entrance. Please let me know your status and any concerns.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change to the electrical setup. During this week's technical test, I measured the planned sound and lighting load and confirmed that the park service can only supply 125 amps, while the draft package requires 200 amps. The good news is that a certified 180 kWh battery trailer is available and can support the full concert load — but I have not yet added its load schedule to the operations packet. I'll need to get that added before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a required change to flag on the permitting side. I confirmed with the city permit office yesterday that the event permit requires all serviceware to be compostable and requires three-stream waste stations for food and beverage areas. The current draft package only includes mixed-waste bins, so that will need to be updated. I also have not yet copied this condition into the festival's sustainability checklist, so I'll need to get that done before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a required change to flag on the transport side. I confirmed with the transit authority this morning that the road-closure approval permits shuttle pickup only at the East Gate, with departures every 15 minutes from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The current transport sheet still shows the West Gate and 30-minute departures, so that will need to be updated before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a required change to flag on the accessibility side. My accessibility inspection found that the accessible audience route must begin at the South Entrance and maintain a clear width of exactly 1.8 meters to the raised viewing platform. The current site map still routes guests from the main entrance and does not record the measured width, so that will need to be updated before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
